verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Computer can read and send email via Gmail and Outlook and schedule calendar events. It connects to 400+ services through a managed connector framework with one-click OAuth, and mid-task auth_required flows resume the session after connecting. This covers the core of connecting personal work accounts for use in tasks. missing for 10: an explicitly named cloud-drive connector (Google Drive/OneDrive/Dropbox; only Google Sheets is named), evidence of searching or reading calendar data rather than just scheduling events, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the connectors working.
